Since 2014

Built on craft, not noise

Jordan's started in 2014 with a simple idea: do the work properly and let it speak. A decade on, that's still the whole philosophy — skilled barbers, an unhurried chair, and a room that feels considered rather than loud.

The new house brings the barbershop together with a beauty floor above, both held to the same editorial standard. Dark, warm, masculine — premium through restraint, not excess.
